title: Frank Ocean - White Ferrari (Lyrics)
rawTtml:
Bad luck to talk on these rides路上的对话不尽人意

Mind on the road, your dilated eyes watch the clouds float逐渐扩大的瞳孔 思绪萦绕在这趟旅程 看着漂浮的云朵

White Ferrari, had a good time(Sweet sixteen, how was I supposed to know anything)脸红的思春期天真懵懂且无知白色法拉利 美好的时光

I let you out at Central与你在家乡的街头分别

I didn't care to state the plain我无需说出显而易见的事实

Kept my mouth closed就这样沉默着吧

We're both so familiar因为我们足够熟悉

White Ferrari, good times白色法拉利 美好的时光

Stick by me, close by me来我身边靠近我

You were fine, you were fine here妙不可言你也很享受吧

That's just a slow body我只是一个迟钝的家伙

You left when I forgot to speak你离开的时候我却哑口无言

So I text the speech, lesser speeds, Texas speed, yes所以我编辑了的短信不急不躁

Basic takes its toll on me, 'ventually, 'ventually, yes我还是为此付出了代价

Ahh, on me 'ventually, 'ventually, yes最终却还是重蹈覆辙

I care for you still and I will forever我仍然会在乎你 我会永远在乎你

That was my part of the deal, honest说真的这是我的问题

We got so familiar我们深知彼此 我们熟悉对方

Spending each day of the year我们互相陪伴度过365天

White Ferrari, good times白色法拉利 美好的时光

In this life(Life)一生的时光

in this life(Life)一生的时光

One too many years时间无法抹去

Some tattooed eyelids on a facelift(Thought you might want to know now)或许现在你想知道了 我们共度过的美好时光

Mind over matter is magic精神大于物质

I do magic这是我的魔法

If you think about it, it'll be over in no time and that's life在乎你也在失去你 这就是人生吧

I'm sure we're taller in another dimension我相信我们的感情在另一个维度会更好

You say we're small and not worth the mention你却说我们太渺小 不值一提

You're tired of movin', your body's achin'你说自己伤痕累累不愿再走下去

We could vacay, there's places to go可我还想带你去很多好玩的地方

Clearly, this isn't all that there is显然我们并不是彼此的全部

Can't take what's been given(No way)你我无法接受彼此的给予

But we're so okay here, we're doing fine但我们现在过得挺好 不如就这样过下去

Primal and naked原来只是原始的赤裸

You dream of walls that hold us in prison你幻想着能困住我们的牢笼

It's just a skull, least that's what they call it只是个头骨至少他们是这么说的

And we're free to roam我们的思想可以自在畅游
